QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] The Weeping Queen
QuestInfo.0: The sound of a woman weeping is coming from the Fifth Tower of the Lion King's castle. Could it be...a ghost? Answer the voice.
QuestInfo.1: #p2161001#... She is saddened because her voice isn't being heard. Who is she? And to whom does she wish to speak? Head to the #bRoof of the Fifth Tower#k and talk to #p2161001#.
QuestInfo.2: The beautiful ghost is #p2161001#, the wife of the Lion King. That means she's the queen of this castle... But even she can't see the Lion King. What kind of person is this Lion King?

0.0: Sniff sniff... Why won't he answer? He wasn't like this before. Does he not hear my voice? Does he not care for a ghost like me? Sniff sniff... Please help me. Please let him hear my words.

yes.0: My goodness! There really is a human here. Are you an adventurer? If you can help me, please come see me. I'm on the #bRoof of the Fifth Tower#k.

no.0: Am I hearing things now? There couldn't be a human in this castle. None have come for hundreds of years... Sniff sniff.

1.0: Oh, you came! You're...real, aren't you? I'm sorry... I've been talking to myself for hundreds of years here. I'm just so happy to be talking to someone else. \r\n#L0##bAre you #p2161001#? #p2161002# told me you might be here.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, I'm sorry. I should have introduced myself. My name is #p2161001#... #p2161001#, the wife of #p2161000# the Lion King. That would make me the Queen... Only if he still remembers me...

yes.0: Won't you talk to me just a little longer? I'm at the #r#m211061001##k.
